findings.finding: A reference-passing controller kept prompt growth linear in iteration count while reported quality improved over eleven drafts. The authors treat the token budget as a design constraint rather than a post-hoc cost.
Scheduling on token estimates instead of wall time held tail latency flat as pipeline stages grew. The trade is a small throughput loss for predictable spend.
